description: Azure Monitor and Policy rules — WSTG 04-09 Authentication Error Detection

rules.name: Authentication — Brute Force Login Attempts
rules.description: Detects high volume of failed authentication attempts from a single source IP indicating brute force attack
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'auth_failed' | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), resource_group, SourceIP | where count_ > 10

rules.name: Authentication — Credential Stuffing Attack
rules.description: Detects credential stuffing attempts using leaked username/password pairs across multiple accounts
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'auth_failed' | summarize dcount(TargetUserName), count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 10m), resource_group, SourceIP | where dcount_TargetUserName > 5 and count_ > 15

rules.name: Authentication — Password Spraying Detection
rules.description: Detects password spraying where a single password is tried against many accounts
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'auth_failed' | summarize dcount(TargetUserName), count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), resource_group, SourceIP | where dcount_TargetUserName > 8

rules.name: Authentication — Account Lockout Storm
rules.description: Detects mass account lockouts indicating potential denial-of-service via authentication flooding
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'account_lockout' | summarize dcount(TargetUserName), count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 10m), resource_group | where dcount_TargetUserName > 5

rules.name: Authentication — Impossible Travel Login
rules.description: Detects successful logins from geographically distant locations within impossible timeframes
rules.query: SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where ResultType == 0 | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, Location | extend lat = parse_json(LocationDetails).latitude, lon = parse_json(LocationDetails).longitude | order by UserPrincipalName, TimeGenerated asc | serialize prev_lat = prev(lat), prev_lon = prev(lon), prev_time = prev(TimeGenerated), prev_user = prev(UserPrincipalName) | where UserPrincipalName == prev_user and abs(lat - prev_lat) + abs(lon - prev_lon) > 30

rules.name: Authentication — Failed Login Then Success (Password Compromise)
rules.description: Detects failed login followed by success from same source indicating potential password compromise
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'auth' | extend auth_result = iff(EventID == 4624, 'success', 'failure') | summarize FailureCount=countif(auth_result=='failure'), SuccessCount=countif(auth_result=='success') by bin(TimeGenerated, 30m), resource_group, SourceIP, TargetUserName | where FailureCount > 3 and SuccessCount > 0

rules.name: Authentication — Default Credential Usage
rules.description: Detects login attempts using known default credentials on systems or devices
rules.query: let default_users = dynamic(["admin", "root", "administrator", "guest", "default", "user", "test"]); AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'auth_success' | where TargetUserName in (default_users) | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), resource_group, TargetUserName, SourceIP | where count_ > 5

rules.name: Authentication — Kerberoasting Attack
rules.description: Detects Kerberos TGS ticket requests consistent with Kerberoasting attacks
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'kerberos' | where ServiceName !startswith "krbtgt" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), resource_group, ClientUserName, ServiceName | where count_ > 10

rules.name: Authentication — Pass-the-Hash Detection
rules.description: Detects NTLM authentication patterns consistent with pass-the-hash attacks
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'auth_success' | where AuthenticationPackageName == "NTLM" and LogonType == 3 | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), resource_group, TargetUserName, SourceIP, WorkstationName | where count_ > 3

rules.name: Authentication — Pass-the-Ticket Detection
rules.description: Detects Kerberos ticket reuse patterns consistent with pass-the-ticket attacks
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'kerberos_success' | where LogonType in (2, 3, 8) | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 10m), resource_group, TargetUserName, IpAddress | where count_ > 5

rules.name: Authentication — Golden Ticket Detection
rules.description: Detects forged Kerberos TGT tickets consistent with Golden Ticket attacks
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'kerberos_tgs' | where Status == "0x0" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), resource_group, TargetUserName, IpAddress | where count_ > 1

rules.name: Authentication — Silver Ticket Detection
rules.description: Detects forged Kerberos TGS tickets consistent with Silver Ticket attacks
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'kerberos_tgs' | where Status == "0x0" and EncryptionType == "0x1" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), resource_group, ClientUserName, ServiceName, IpAddress

rules.name: Authentication — AS-REP Roasting
rules.description: Detects AS-REP roasting attacks targeting accounts with pre-authentication disabled
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'kerberos_asrep' | where Status in ("0x6", "0x7", "0x8") | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 10m), resource_group, TargetUserName, IpAddress | where count_ > 5

rules.name: Authentication — LLMNR/NBT-NS Poisoning
rules.description: Detects LLMNR or NBT-NS name resolution poisoning attempts for credential relay attacks
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'dns_resolution' | where Protocol in ("LLMNR", "NBNS") | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 10m), resource_group, SourceIP | where count_ > 10

rules.name: Authentication — Credential Dumping via LSASS
rules.description: Detects process access to LSASS memory indicative of credential dumping
rules.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4663 | where ObjectName contains "lsass.exe" | where ProcessName !in ("csrss.exe", "wininit.exe", "taskhostw.exe", "svchost.exe") | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ProcessName, SubjectUserName

rules.name: Authentication — SAM Database Access
rules.description: Detects unauthorized access to the SAM database for credential extraction
rules.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4663 | where ObjectName contains "SAM" | where ProcessName !in ("lsass.exe", "wininit.exe", "svchost.exe") | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ProcessName, SubjectUserName

rules.name: Authentication — NTDS.DIT Extraction
rules.description: Detects access to NTDS.DIT Active Directory database for credential harvesting
rules.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4663 | where ObjectName contains "ntds.dit" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ProcessName, SubjectUserName

rules.name: Authentication — DCSync Attack
rules.description: Detects DCSync replication requests used to extract domain credentials
rules.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4662 | where Properties contains "Replicating Directory Changes" | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), SubjectUserName, ObjectName

rules.name: Authentication — MFA Bypass Attempt
rules.description: Detects authentication flows that bypass multi-factor authentication controls
rules.query: SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(15m) | where ResultType == 0 | where AuthenticationDetails has "MFA" and AuthenticationDetails !contains "MFA completed" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), UserPrincipalName, AppDisplayName | where count_ > 3

rules.name: Authentication — OAuth Token Abuse
rules.description: Detects suspicious OAuth token usage patterns indicating token theft or abuse
rules.query: SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where ResultType == 0 | where AuthenticationProcessingDetails has "OAuth" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), UserPrincipalName, AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed | where count_ > 20

rules.name: Authentication — Privileged Account Anomalous Login
rules.description: Detects anomalous login patterns for privileged accounts outside normal hours or locations
rules.query: SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where ResultType == 0 | where AppDisplayName contains "Azure" | where UserPrincipalName in ("admin@", "root@") or UserPrincipalName endswith "-admin@" | where hod(TimeGenerated) !between (6 .. 20) | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), UserPrincipalName, Location

rules.name: Authentication — Session Token Replay
rules.description: Detects session token reuse from different source IPs indicating token replay attacks
rules.query: SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(30m) | where ResultType == 0 | where CorrelationId != "" | summarize dcount(IpAddress), count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 30m), CorrelationId, UserPrincipalName | where dcount_IpAddress > 2 and count_ > 5

rules.name: Authentication — LDAP Simple Bind
rules.description: Detects LDAP simple bind operations that transmit credentials in cleartext
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'ldap_bind' | where BindMethod == "Simple" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 10m), resource_group, TargetUserName, SourceIP | where count_ > 5

rules.name: Authentication — SQL Injection Authentication Bypass
rules.description: Detects SQL injection patterns in authentication forms that bypass login controls
rules.query: let sqli_patterns = dynamic(["' OR 1=1", "' OR '", "admin'--", "1; DROP", "UNION SELECT", "' UNION", "1=1", "OR TRUE"]); AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'waf' | where RequestQuery has_any (sqli_patterns) or RequestBody has_any (sqli_patterns) | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), resource_group, SourceIP | where count_ > 3

rules.name: Authentication — JWT Token Manipulation
rules.description: Detects JWT token manipulation attempts including algorithm confusion and signature bypass
rules.query: let jwt_patterns = dynamic(["alg.none", "alg.None", "algorithm:none"]); AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'gateway' | where RequestHeaders has_any (jwt_patterns) or RequestBody has_any (jwt_patterns) | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), resource_group, SourceIP

rules.name: Authentication — SAML Token Forging
rules.description: Detects SAML token forging attempts and XML signature wrapping attacks
rules.query: SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(10m) | where ResultType in (50053, 50074, 50076) | where AuthenticationProtocol == "SAML" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 10m), UserPrincipalName, IpAddress | where count_ > 2

rules.name: Authentication — Credential Relaying via NTLM
rules.description: Detects NTLM relay attacks forwarding authentication to downstream servers
rules.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4624 | where AuthenticationPackageName == "NTLM" and LogonType == 3 | where TargetUserName !endswith "$" | summarize dcount(TargetServerName), count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 10m), TargetUserName, SourceIP | where dcount_TargetServerName > 3

rules.name: Authentication — DNS-Based Authentication Bypass
rules.description: Detects DNS manipulation used to bypass authentication or redirect traffic
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'dns' | where QueryType in ("A", "AAAA", "CNAME") | where Name has_any ("login", "auth", "sso", "vpn") | summarize dcount(IPAddresses), count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 10m), ClientIP, Name | where dcount_IPAddresses > 2

rules.name: Authentication — Weak Password Detection
rules.description: Detects accounts authenticating with weak passwords found in known breach databases
rules.query: SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where ResultType == 0 | where AuthenticationDetails has "Password" | join kind=inner (IdentityInfo | where IsPasswordExpired == true or PasswordLastChange < ago(365d)) on UserPrincipalName | project UserPrincipalName, LastPasswordChange=PasswordLastChange

rules.name: Authentication — Admin Account Enumeration
rules.description: Detects attempts to enumerate admin or privileged accounts via LDAP or directory queries
rules.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID in (4662, 5136) | where Properties has_any ("admin", "Admin", "Domain Admins", "Enterprise Admins") | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 10m), SubjectUserName, SourceIP | where count_ > 10

rules.name: Authentication — Service Account Abuse
rules.description: Detects service accounts used for interactive logins or unusual access patterns
rules.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4624 | where TargetUserName endswith "$" | where LogonType in (2, 10, 7) | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), TargetUserName, SourceIP, WorkstationName | where count_ > 3

rules.name: Authentication — Certificate-based Auth Fraud
rules.description: Detects fraudulent certificate-based authentication including stolen or forged certificates
rules.query: SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(15m) | where ResultType == 0 | where AuthenticationProtocol == "X509" | where AuthenticationProcessingDetails has_any ("certificate", "smartcard") | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), UserPrincipalName, IpAddress | where count_ > 5

rules.name: Authentication — PTH Over WinRM
rules.description: Detects pass-the-hash attack patterns over WinRM connections
rules.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4624 | where AuthenticationPackageName == "NTLM" and LogonType == 3 | where ProcessName has "winrm" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), TargetUserName, SourceIP

rules.name: Authentication — Forged PAC Attack
rules.description: Detects privilege attribute certificate manipulation in Kerberos tickets
rules.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4769 | where Status == "0x0" | where Properties has_any ("PAC", "Privilege", "forged") | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ClientUserName, ServiceName, IpAddress

rules.name: Authentication — Downgrade Attack on Auth Protocol
rules.description: Detects authentication protocol downgrade from Kerberos to NTLM indicating potential downgrade attacks
rules.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4624 | where AuthenticationPackageName == "NTLM" | where TargetUserName !endswith "$" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 10m), TargetUserName, IpAddress | join kind=inner (SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4624 | where AuthenticationPackageName == "Kerberos" | where TargetUserName !endswith "$" | summarize count() by TargetUserName) on TargetUserName | where count_ > 5

rules.name: Authentication — Idle Session Hijacking
rules.description: Detects session hijacking of idle authenticated sessions
rules.query: SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where ResultType == 0 | where SessionLifetime > 8h | where TimeSinceLastActivity > 30m | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), UserPrincipalName, IpAddress | where count_ > 2

rules.name: Authentication — Broken Authentication Session Management
rules.description: Detects broken authentication session management including session fixation and insecure cookie flags
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'gateway' | where RequestMethod == "POST" | where RequestUri has_any ("login", "auth", "session") | where ResponseCode in (200, 302) | where ResponseHeaders !contains "Secure" or ResponseHeaders !contains "HttpOnly" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 10m), resource_group, SourceIP | where count_ > 10

rules.name: Authentication — Cross-Site Request Forgery on Auth
rules.description: Detects CSRF attacks targeting authentication endpoints
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'waf' | where RequestMethod == "POST" | where RequestUri has_any ("login", "password", "auth", "changepwd") | where RequestHeaders !contains "X-CSRF" and RequestHeaders !contains "X-Requested-With" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 10m), resource_group, SourceIP | where count_ > 5

rules.name: Authentication — Insecure Password Reset
rules.description: Detects abuse of insecure password reset mechanisms including predictable tokens
rules.query: SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(30m) | where ResultType in (50055, 50056, 50057) | where AuthenticationProcessingDetails has_any ("password-reset", "forgot-password") | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 30m), UserPrincipalName, IpAddress | where count_ > 5

rules.name: Authentication — Concurrent Session Anomaly
rules.description: Detects anomalous concurrent sessions from multiple locations for the same user
rules.query: SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where ResultType == 0 | summarize dcount(IpAddress), dcount(Location), count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), UserPrincipalName | where dcount_IpAddress > 3 and dcount_Location > 2

rules.name: Authentication — Expired Credential Usage
rules.description: Detects authentication attempts with expired credentials suggesting credential reuse or theft
rules.query: SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(30m) | where ResultType == 50055 | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 30m), UserPrincipalName, IpAddress | where count_ > 3

rules.name: Authentication — RDP Brute Force
rules.description: Detects brute force attacks targeting Remote Desktop Protocol authentication
rules.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4625 | where LogonType in (10, 7) | where AuthenticationPackageName == "Negotiate" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), TargetUserName, SourceIP | where count_ > 10

rules.name: Authentication — SSH Brute Force
rules.description: Detects brute force attacks targeting SSH authentication on Linux systems
rules.query: Syslog | where Facility == "auth" | where SyslogMessage contains "Failed password" | extend src_ip = extract(@"from ([0-9.]+)", 1, SyslogMessage) | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), src_ip | where count_ > 10

rules.name: Authentication — Account Manipulation
rules.description: Detects account manipulation including privilege escalation, group modification, and attribute changes
rules.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID in (4720, 4722, 4723, 4724, 4725, 4726, 4728, 4729, 4730, 4731, 4732, 4733, 4734, 4735, 4737, 4738, 4740, 4741, 4742, 4743, 4754, 4755, 4756, 4757, 4758, 4764) | where TargetUserName !endswith "$" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 10m), EventID, SubjectUserName, TargetUserName | where count_ > 3

rules.name: Authentication — Conditional Access Policy Bypass
rules.description: Detects attempts to bypass conditional access policies through legacy protocols or exemption abuse
rules.query: SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(30m) | where ResultType == 0 | where ConditionalAccessPolicies has "notApplied" or ConditionalAccessPolicies has "reportOnlyMode" | where ClientAppUsed in ("Exchange ActiveSync", "IMAP", "POP3", "SMTP") | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 30m), UserPrincipalName, ClientAppUsed | where count_ > 5
